label: agreement
notes: Bilateral procurement agreement. The third party participates through its own contract, not a third signatory on this contract.

attributes.name: signed_at
attributes.label: signed_at
attributes.meaning: Server-recorded UTC business time; caller may not supply this field.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.label: quantity
attributes.meaning: Buyer-agreed total quantity, positive and fully deliverable.

attributes.name: tier_threshold
attributes.label: tier_threshold
attributes.meaning: Quantity at or above which tier two applies to the entire order.

attributes.name: tier1_unit_price_minor
attributes.label: tier1_unit_price_minor
attributes.meaning: Seller-agreed unit price below the tier threshold. In CNY minor units (fen), never a floating-point yuan amount.

attributes.name: tier2_unit_price_minor
attributes.label: tier2_unit_price_minor
attributes.meaning: Seller-agreed unit price at or above the tier threshold. In CNY minor units (fen), never a floating-point yuan amount.

attributes.name: tax_bps
attributes.label: tax_bps
attributes.meaning: Contractual tax in basis points, inclusive range 0..10000.

attributes.name: retention_bps
attributes.label: retention_bps
attributes.meaning: Contractual retained warranty share, inclusive range 0..10000.

attributes.name: daily_penalty_bps
attributes.label: daily_penalty_bps
attributes.meaning: Penalty basis points per started 24-hour period, inclusive range 0..10000.

attributes.name: delivery_deadline
attributes.label: delivery_deadline
attributes.meaning: Agreed delivery acceptance deadline in UTC; a contract term, not a server stamp.
